subject: Internal triage: BYOK + SSO + audit log asks — action plan

Subject: Initial audit asks: BYOK, SSO, and detailed audit logs

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Security has a few gating items they need before procurement can move forward:
- BYOK/KMS: we need details on supported key rotation, HSM integration, and the onboarding flow for customer-managed keys.
- SSO: SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning behaviour (what fields are synced), and an admin UX for disabling accounts.
- Audit logs: retention guarantees (schema + retention periods), ability to export per-customer logs, and evidence of immutable append-only logs.

I've attached a short pdf with the initial questionnaire and timelines (ACME requires answers by Dec 10 to hit their Jan 1 deployment). Can you point us to the right owners and a plan?

Appreciate it,
Maya
Security Program Manager, ACME Corp
Attachments: ACME_Audit_Request.pdf (questionnaire, 6 pages)

Team — looping you in to triage ACME's request and surface any blockers. High level: customer needs BYOK onboarding details, SSO/SCIM specifics, and concrete audit log retention/export guarantees.

Proposed short plan:
1) Quick intake (this week) — confirm gaps vs. questionnaire and flag any feature exceptions required. Owner: Marissa
2) Security deep-dive (tech write-up) — produce a short doc describing BYOK/KMS flow + HSM options and known limitations (e.g., no in-place per-tenant key rotation today). Owner: Neha
3) Product response for SSO/SCIM and admin UX constraints — include SCIM attribute mapping and timeline for any missing controls. Owner: Marcus
4) Customer-facing MAP document with milestones and attachments (we send to Maya). Owner: Connor (I will draft)

Can each of you reply with availability for a 30-minute sync tomorrow and any immediate no-go items. If this requires policy exceptions or dev cycles >2 sprints, note that in your reply.

Connor O'Brien

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Shah <maya.shah@acme.com>, secops@acme.com
Date: 2026-12-02T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initial audit asks: BYOK, SSO, and detailed audit logs

Thanks Connor — availability OK for a sync tomorrow 10:00-10:30 PT. Initial technical notes (quick and dirty):
- BYOK/KMS:
  * We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and Azure Key Vault today. Flow: customer provides key ARN/ID -> we create per-tenant envelope key wrapped by their key. Rotation: we do not rotate customer keys on their behalf; they must rotate and rewrap.
  * HSM: we currently rely on cloud KMS HSM-backed keys; we do not offer dedicated on-prem HSM connectors out of the box. Possible engineering project (estimated 4-6 wks) to add HSM appliance bridging for Private deployments.
- SSO/SCIM:
  * SAML: metadata endpoint + X509 certs supported.
  * SCIM: supports core attributes (userName, name, emails, groups). Custom attribute sync not guaranteed — we can accept mapping requests as engineering tickets.
  * Admin UX: we have account disablement and session revoke endpoints; full centralized admin console controls for enterprise-down provisioning are on the roadmap (Q1 next year).
- Audit logs:
  * Log schema: event, actor, resource, action, timestamp, request_id.
  * Retention: hosted default retention 90 days; we can do extended retention as an add-on (up to 3 years) with export-to-object-storage. For exports per-customer we can generate daily S3 exports (cost + 48h lag).
  * Immutability: logs are stored in write-once buckets with lifecycle; evidence package available for SOC2, but we do not provide a dedicated append-only ledger (e.g., blockchain-style).

Immediate implication: if ACME requires customer-driven key rotation managed by Redwood, that is currently a gap (needs product decision). Also, if they require SCIM to sync custom attributes into our RBAC engine, that would need an engineering spec.

I will pull a short technical appendix and attach by EOD for the sync.

— Neha
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Retention SLAs: shipping extended retention as add-on vs. promising exports only.
- SCIM attribute coverage: commit to core attributes only for GA; custom attributes as professional services.

- Neha: provide the technical appendix and security attestation language by EOD Dec 5 (for procurement).
- Marcus: produce a short UX note on SCIM/admin UX limitations and next steps by Dec 8.
- Connor: escalate any leadership decisions that block answers to me by Dec 6.

Maya — attaching the MAP draft and the technical appendix. Please flag anything missing or timeline out of alignment; we want to give ACME clear answers by Dec 10.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Enterprise Security Integrations, Redwood Inference
